title: DI in action
description: Explore practical patterns for dependency injection in Angular: optional dependencies, multi-providers, and custom injectors.

blocks.text: This guide demonstrates practical design patterns and techniques for using dependency injection in real-world Angular applications.
Use the optional: true flag when calling inject() if a service is not strictly required at runtime:
Use multi: true to associate multiple provider implementations with a single token, which Angular injects as an array (common with interceptors, validators, and app initializers):

code: { provide: APP_INITIALIZER, useFactory: initTheme, multi: true },
{ provide: APP_INITIALIZER, useFactory: initAuth, multi: true }
